talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 18 solo PCPs winding down in Arkansas; 1 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Forrest City 72335) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~3,353 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Lee County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 14 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~52,800 patients across 44 at-risk practices statewide.
